title: I'm making an anime idle clicker RPG and here's the trailer
author: wizzone
selftext:
Frontierra Clicker is an anime-inspired idle clicker RPG where your hero lineup determines your team's ultimate ability. Choose each hero's job path, decide which skills they equip, and hunt for better gear. Your heroes fight automatically, and you can click for extra damage to take down monsters and bosses.

The Steam page went live about a week ago. I held off on actively promoting it at first because I was curious how much traffic Steam would bring in on its own. Now I'm starting to share the game outside Steam, so here's the trailer while I work on the demo.

I'm making the game in Godot. I use Codex to help with coding and testing, and AI image generation for the characters and environments. Keeping the art style consistent throughout the game has been one of the biggest challenges.

[Frontierra Clicker on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5495590/Frontierra_Clicker/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=aigamedev_trailer)
